author: Disney Parks YouTube
text:
Adassa shared that the first stage-adaptation of #Encanto is coming to the #DisneyBelieve 🚢
Setting sail in late 2027, the Disney Believe promises one-of-a-kind venues and entertainment experiences that will be shaped by some of Disney’s most beloved stories, including Disney Animation’s Encanto, Frozen, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, Moana and The Little Mermaid.

To read more and a full recap, visit the Disney Parks Blog: https://disneyparksblog.com/dcl/meet-the-disney-believe-the-next-disney-cruise-line-ship/

author: Disney Parks YouTube
text:
101 Year Old War Hero Becomes a #Disneyland Citizen 🏰🇺🇸
Medal of Honor recipient and retired U.S. Navy Captain, 101-year-old E. Royce Williams served as an aviator in World War II, the Korean War and the Vietnam War 🇺🇸 This week, he was named an Honorary Citizen of Disneyland and took to the skies once again on Soarin' Over America 🛫
